typeWhy.TD01: Issued now, within 12 days of the DDT.
typeWhy.TD24: One invoice for the month’s DDTs, by the 15th of the next month; it names each DDT.

fromDdts.valueHint: Without VAT; the draft computes the VAT

sdi.about: SDI is the tax agency’s post office for invoices: in Italy the invoice is the XML file SDI accepts; the PDF is only a courtesy copy.
sdi.copyMissing: No contact has an e-mail address: send a copy from the thread.
sdi.copySent: We e-mailed the customer a copy on {date}.
sdi.deadlineOverdue: The time to send it again ended on {date}: send it now.
sdi.deadline_one: Fix it and send it again by {date} ({count} working day left), with the same number and date.
sdi.deadline_other: Fix it and send it again by {date} ({count} working days left), with the same number and date.

draft.body: Check and issue sends it to SDI.
draft.title: Not sent yet

explain.AT_SDI: SDI received the file and is checking and delivering it: it answers within minutes, at most in five days.
explain.DELIVERED: SDI delivered the invoice to the customer. It is issued and final.
explain.DRAFT: A draft has no number and is not sent. SDI receives it once it is issued.
explain.ERROR: The send did not finish: the file may not have reached SDI.
explain.NOT_DELIVERED: SDI could not reach the customer’s address. The invoice is still legally issued and waits in the customer’s tax drawer.
explain.NOT_SENT: The invoice has its number, but SDI does not have it yet.
explain.REJECTED: SDI rejected the file: the invoice counts as never issued. Fix it and send it again with the same number and date.
explain.SENDING: The file is going to SDI through the intermediary.

failure.REFUSED: The intermediary refused the file before SDI: it never reached SDI.

sdi.failureUncertain: It may have reached SDI: we ask the intermediary before sending again.

fixWhere.company: Fix it in our company’s data, then send again.
fixWhere.lines: Fix it in the lines here.
fixWhere.none: Nothing to change: send it again.
fixWhere.party: Fix it on the customer, then send again.
fixWhere.text: Fix it in the invoice’s text here.

next.CHECK_COPY: The customer finds it in the tax drawer; we e-mailed a copy. Send another copy if they ask.
next.FIX_AND_RESEND: Fix it and send it again with the same number and date.
next.ISSUE: Check and issue it, then it goes to SDI.
next.SEND_AGAIN: Send it again: we ask the intermediary first, so it is never sent twice.
next.WAIT: Nothing to do: SDI’s answer arrives by itself.

sdi.noErrorList: SDI gave no list of errors.

notification.AT: Could not be delivered: handed to the tax drawer

sdiError.c00001: SDI did not accept the file name.
sdiError.c00002: SDI already has a file with this name; the next send uses a new name.
sdiError.c00102: The file’s signature is not valid (the intermediary signs it).
sdiError.c00200: The file does not follow the FatturaPA format.
sdiError.c00301: Our company’s VAT number is not valid at the tax agency.
sdiError.c00305: The customer’s VAT number is not valid at the tax agency.
sdiError.c00306: The customer’s tax code (codice fiscale) is not valid at the tax agency.
sdiError.c00311: The customer’s SDI code does not exist.
sdiError.c00312: The customer’s SDI code is not active.
sdiError.c00400: A line at 0% VAT has no reason (Natura).
sdiError.c00401: A line with VAT above 0% carries a reason (Natura); only 0% lines carry one.
sdiError.c00403: The invoice date is later than the day SDI received it.
sdiError.c00404: SDI already has an invoice with this number and date from this company (a duplicate).
sdiError.c00409: The same invoice appears twice in the file.
sdiError.c00418: The invoice is dated before the invoice it refers to.
sdiError.c00421: The VAT of a rate is not computed as SDI computes it.
sdiError.c00422: The taxable amount of a rate is not the sum of its lines.
sdiError.c00423: A line’s total is not its quantity × unit price less the discount.
sdiError.c00424: A VAT rate is not written as a percentage.
sdiError.c00425: The invoice number has no digit.
sdiError.c00427: The customer’s SDI code has the wrong length for a business invoice (7 characters).
sdiError.c00429: A 0% VAT summary has no reason (Natura).
sdiError.c00430: A VAT summary above 0% carries a reason (Natura).
sdiError.c00443: The lines’ VAT rates and the summary’s do not match.
sdiError.c00444: The lines’ reasons (Natura) and the summary’s do not match.

send.body: The invoice of {date} goes to SDI through the intermediary. Its answer comes by itself.

accountant.explain: These points are our reading, not yet confirmed. Invoices follow them now; the accountant’s answer changes a setting, not the code.

point.foreignConsumer: A private customer abroad without a tax id: which convention FatturaPA takes (not needed for the first customer, a business).
point.progressive: The 5-character file progressive can collide after thousands of invoices; the send picks a free name. To check with the real intermediary.
point.resendDays: A rejected invoice is sent again within 5 working days (Saturday not counted) or 5 days.

rule.EU_B2C_GOODS_ITALIAN_VAT: EU consumers pay Italian VAT while each company stays under the EU distance-sales threshold of 10,000 euro.
rule.STAMP_DUTY: Which reasons without VAT are free of the 2.00 euro stamp duty (now N3.1, N3.2 and the reverse-charge codes).
